page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top, centred. Catchword at the foot, right. No marginal notes. Underlining in ink across parts of the first column is handwriting and is not transcribed.

p.i: ciscam[?],canonizauit, ob id quod voluptatem inui-ti coitus, ardente supra vuluam lardo posito, re-primere solebat. Ex Leandro & Mantuano: Sub eodem Iulio noua haeresis orta est, super loco con-ceptionis Christi in virgine matre. Rtolemaeus[?] qui-dam Lucensis, Cisterciensis ordinis monachus, in quodam templo Mantuae praedicabat, Christum fu-isse iuxta cor eiusdem virginis ex tribus guttulis sanguinis conceptum, & non in utero, ut alij, iuxta communem naturae ordinem, hunc statim in ignem coniiciendum esse iudicabant Hieronymus Fauen-tinus & alij Dominicani, haereticorum magistri. At Baptista Mantuanus mitius cum illo agendum fo-re decernebat, quum non ex malicia, sed praecipiti quadam ac licentiosa ignorantia, id protulerit. un-de idem Baptista libellum scripsit, de vero Christi conceptionis loco per scripturas: & inde extin-ctus est ille stultissimus error, ex hypocritico mo-nachorum ocio natus.

main_text.p: Iulius iste, bellator insignis, cum exercitu, ut dictum est, egrediens urbem, petri clauem in Tyberim proiecit, hisce verbis: Quia clauis S. petri non amplius valet, valeat gladius S. pauli. De quo Gilbertus Ducherius:

p.i: In Gallum, ut fama est, bellum gesturus acerbum, Armatam educit Iulius urbe manum:

page.notes: Page number "480" is read from a superscript 8 in the running head line; doubtful. Running head "PONTIFICVM" printed with V, changed to U as a vowel. Opening word "ciscam" is a fragment and doubtful. "Rtolemaeus" is read as printed with an R; the initial may be a P. Catchword "Accin" is partly worn and doubtful. Handwritten ink underlining under "Sub eodem ... matre" and "Baptista Mantuanus" is not transcribed.
